description: Our twelve-storey residential tower has eighty apartments, with the highest occupied floor 33 m above grade. The elevators are ordinary passenger elevators; none would be provided for firefighter use. The developer proposes relying on the stairs for firefighters instead. We need the application checklist for that change.
known_facts: highest occupied floor 33 m above grade
no elevator provided for firefighter use
